pre: ip link add d0 address 02:00:00:00:02:00 type dummy && ip link set d0 addrgenmode none && ip link set d0 up && ip link add d1 address 02:00:00:00:02:01 type dummy && ip link set d1 addrgenmode none && ip link set d1 up
tc actions add action simple sdata hello index 1
tc actions add action sample rate 100 group 5 trunc 64 index 1
tc actions add action gact pass index 1 cookie 0102
i=2; while [ $i -le 33 ]; do tc actions add action gact drop index $i || exit 1; i=$((i+1)); done
tc qdisc add dev d0 clsact
tc filter add dev d0 ingress pref 1 protocol all handle 1 matchall action gact pass action mirred egress redirect dev d1 action skbedit priority 5
printf '%s\n' 'actions get action gact index 1' 'actions get action simple index 1' > b.txt
